evidence_required: A verdict per line, with the rule applied.

marking.criterion: (a) GPU at x8 of x16 under load is a fault (critical), because width below capability is never benign
(b) idle GPU at 2.5 GT/s x16 is probably benign, verify under load (power-saving downshift, full width)
(c) VGA 5 GT/s x1 of 5 GT/s x1 is healthy (status equals capability)
(d) rail NIC at Gen4 x16 under load is a fault (warning), with the bandwidth consequence (31.5 GB/s raw, about 26 GB/s achievable, below 50 GB/s line rate)

title: PCIe status lines
